states.visible_content_copy: Two continuity copies disagree on some saved fields. This device keeps its saved information unchanged while the difference is shown.
Continuity is off. Signed-in account details and information saved on this device remain available.
This destination is already open. The screen currently in view remains unchanged.
Capture and Search are closed. The current screen and keyboard focus remain unchanged.
Capture or Search has closed. The screen used before it opened remains visible.
Part of the saved Capture has been placed, while the remaining part is still pending. Both portions remain visible.
The saved Capture is being organized into the selected Ambitions item. Its original text remains visible.
A continuity update is waiting. Information already saved on this device remains unchanged.
Saved setup progress cannot be used. Earlier product information and choices outside setup remain unchanged.
This Step is in progress. Still counts, Move it, Blocked, Waiting, and Not needed keep its real outcome visible.
The selected outcome, any required Proof, and the resulting History entry are visible before Confirm Closure.
The Step was interrupted. Its last saved progress remains visible.
Earlier trust details are loading again. The last accepted information and its History links remain visible.
This recorded change is still being matched with the item it describes. The saved item remains unchanged.
Earlier details for this recorded change are loading again. The saved item and History remain unchanged.
Recovery of an earlier value is in progress. The current value and both History entries remain visible.
Continuity copies disagree. Saved Goals, Captures, time, and preferences remain unchanged on this device.
